source_comparison.method: Token comparison preserves strings, ignores comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas and normalizes family scope, module facades, receive helper association and consuming notification/constructor routing. limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
Notification receipt keeps its original numeric ASID/CQ destination, not a new captured queue-lifetime interest.
Notification/source field destruction, PreparedReceive Drop and containing transfer/receive disposal retain their existing outer IRQ/guard/destructor qualification boundaries.
No result/adoption authority from readiness, physical quiescence, replay or recovery custody.
No broader pressure/fairness, model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
